manual.umbral.inspection.title: Inspect visitors
manual.umbral.inspection.summary: Check carried items without confiscating anything.
manual.umbral.inspection.tags: Safe entrance · FILTRO · TNT · inventory · scanner · weapon · shulker
manual.umbral.inspection.step1: Place a FILTRO kit on solid floor with 3 × 3 free space. The arch has a real 1 × 2 opening. Pair it to the core; use cable on its control column or local radio from a connected node. Since 1.4.1, trims automatically meet complete touching wall and ceiling faces; removing the support retracts them. The adapters are thin graphite and steel sheets, recessed behind the ivory pillars.
manual.umbral.inspection.step2: In Rules, Basic lets you click an inventory item or use Held item without typing identifiers. Explosives adds four rules. Open Advanced to enter identifiers or #tags and adjust thresholds: 1 detects any item; a higher threshold allows fewer. Exceptions lets a player carry a particular item.
manual.umbral.inspection.step3: Open the mode selector and choose Record to log findings, Raise alarm to add a 2-second redstone pulse, or Check entry to require a clear inspection and valid pass. Check entry needs a physical door and its reader. Link them through NEXO → Create access, with optional FILTRO, or with the configurator; align the door 1–4 blocks behind the arch. Then configure rules, choose the mode and press Activate. Saving links does not activate FILTRO or issue passes. The arch creates no invisible barrier.
manual.umbral.inspection.tip: The owner is exempt; Test my inventory verifies rules. Approval lasts 10 seconds and the pass rechecks inventory. This is not a tailgating barrier: someone can follow through an open door.
manual.umbral.filter.title: FILTRO · Inspection arch
manual.umbral.filter.tags: arch · filter · restrictions · items · tags · exceptions
manual.umbral.filter.step1: One kit places both columns and the lintel. All parts share an owner; cable connects only to the base with the screen. Click any frame part for its console. Also configure it from connected NEXO, core or terminal. Since 1.4.1, trims automatically meet complete touching wall and ceiling faces; removing the support retracts them. The adapters are thin graphite and steel sheets, recessed behind the ivory pillars.
manual.umbral.filter.step2: Basic adds restrictions by clicking inventory items; Advanced edits identifiers, #tags and thresholds. Switching views preserves rules. Each arch supports up to 16 rules and 16 exceptions per rule. Counts include inventory, hands and armor, including items inside shulkers, bundles and containers using vanilla components, up to 8 levels and 4096 stacks.
manual.umbral.filter.step3: Choose Record, Raise alarm or Check entry, then press Activate: saving rules or links does not activate the arch. Check entry requires a physical door, reader, clear inspection and valid pass; there is no invisible barrier. While active, five laser rays connect the columns. A real inspection triggers the sweep and a restricted item makes the rays flash red. The last 16 inspections show player, result and items; NEXO receives notices. Exceptions use UUID even if the player changes name.
manual.umbral.filter.tip: Does not inspect remote Ender Chest or special inventories from other mods. An overly complex inventory denies Access. If disconnected or broken, the linked door fails closed for visitors; its owner can remove FILTRO from the reader. Interior exit remains available. Cable can enter underneath the column with the screen: its metal base covers the opening. Place the cable first and keep solid floor under the other foot.

manual.umbral.perimeter.title: Electrify the perimeter
manual.umbral.perimeter.summary: A chain-link fence you can switch on, switch off and divide into sectors.
manual.umbral.perimeter.step1: Place CERCO like a fence. It joins sections and solid walls; supports adapt at ends and corners. Sections can be stacked.
manual.umbral.perimeter.step2: Use the configurator on your core, then pair one section. It becomes the feeder. Each circuit supports 128 sections.
manual.umbral.perimeter.step3: Select CERCO in NEXO, choose targets and arm it. Control switches NEXO/redstone; apply signal at the feeder.
manual.umbral.perimeter.tip: Amber means contact discharge is active. Offline sections do not shock. Configure territory separately: CERCO does not protect blocks.
manual.umbral.perimeter.tags: cerco fence electricity perimeter redstone copper iron
manual.umbral.fence.title: CERCO · Electrifiable chain-link fence
manual.umbral.fence.summary: Diamond wire mesh, slim stakes every three blocks and a compact feeder box.
manual.umbral.fence.step1: The recipe makes 6 sections using iron, iron bars, copper, quartz and redstone. Each section has an owner.
manual.umbral.fence.step2: Each line shares one feeder. Cable the feeder or place it within core/repeater coverage. Connected additions you own join automatically.
manual.umbral.fence.step3: Hostiles affects monsters only. Intruders adds unauthorized players, respecting server PvP. Shocks deal 2 hearts, at most once per second per entity and circuit.
manual.umbral.fence.tip: Owner, allies and valid network pass holders are exempt. Disarm before joining circuits. Cutting a line leaves isolated sections without discharge.
manual.umbral.fence.tags: cerco fence activate deactivate electrify pass allies pvp
manual.umbral.airlock.title: Airlock entry
manual.umbral.airlock.summary: Two doors coordinated by FILTRO and NEXO to inspect one admission at a time.
manual.umbral.airlock.step1: Place FILTRO between two outward-facing doors: outside door 1–4 blocks ahead, inside door 1–4 behind, on the same axis and height. Separate the doors by at least 3 blocks.
manual.umbral.airlock.step2: Pair the devices with your network and aim an outside reader at the first door. In NEXO select FILTRO → Airlock, choose doors and width, then save.
manual.umbral.airlock.step3: Add FILTRO rules and enable with both doors closed. Visitors present a pass, enter alone, cross the arch and wait. The inside door opens after the outside door closes and inspection clears.
manual.umbral.airlock.tip: Build walls, a roof and territory protection. Multiple occupants, a revoked pass or restricted items return visitors outside. Exit from inside needs no pass; the owner can recover a broken airlock at the reader.
manual.umbral.airlock.tags: airlock doors filtro nexo pass inspection entrance exit

manual.umbral.start.title: Welcome to UMBRAL
manual.umbral.start.summary: Protect your base and connect an installation that you can monitor and maintain through NEXO.
manual.umbral.start.step1: Start with “Protect my base”. The configurator marks the area; matrices provide permanent capacity.
manual.umbral.start.step2: Continue with “Connect devices”. A core identifies the installation; cables and nodes connect your equipment.
manual.umbral.start.step3: Then choose surveillance, access, defenses or logistics. Each guide has a diagram, three steps and the world recipe.
manual.umbral.start.tip: The “?” buttons open the device chapter directly. You can read help without carrying the book.
manual.umbral.start.tags: start help manual beginner installation base
manual.umbral.first_base.title: Protect my base
manual.umbral.first_base.summary: Mark two corners, review the volume and confirm once. A preview is not active protection yet.
manual.umbral.first_base.step1: Use the configurator in the air and choose “Protect my base”. Mark two ground corners with that same tool.
manual.umbral.first_base.step2: The proposal includes 16 blocks of height. Check the 3D model, adjust floor and ceiling if needed, and name the base.
manual.umbral.first_base.step3: Choose “Review”, then “Confirm protection”. Only missing matrices are installed and the complete area becomes active.
manual.umbral.first_base.tip: Green means saved protection; orange means a proposal. Before confirmation, matrices and active protection stay unchanged.
manual.umbral.first_base.tags: protect area territory height corners house creeper explosion
manual.umbral.expansion.title: Expand without redrawing
manual.umbral.expansion.summary: Keep the saved base and mark only the new wing, floor or workshop.
manual.umbral.expansion.step1: Open Areas, select your base and choose “Expand”. Mark two corners of the new section.
manual.umbral.expansion.step2: Review the joined shape in 3D. Height adjustments affect the addition; the existing base keeps its original bounds.
manual.umbral.expansion.step3: Review the cost and confirm. Spare capacity needs no new matrix. NEXO can also suggest additions from detected building work.
manual.umbral.expansion.tip: Building outside does not automatically extend protection. A NEXO notice offers a proposal for you to review and confirm.
manual.umbral.expansion.tags: expand extension workshop building addition floor height redraw nexo
manual.umbral.installation.title: Connect devices
manual.umbral.installation.summary: An installation combines copper wiring with local wireless coverage from connected cores and nodes.
manual.umbral.installation.step1: Place your network core and touch it with the configurator. Its overlay shows the coordinates of the selected installation.
manual.umbral.installation.step2: Connect nodes to the core with continuous copper cable. Touch each node and device with the configurator to pair it.
manual.umbral.installation.step3: Devices can use a cable or sit within 16 blocks of a connected core or node. Check their connection status.
manual.umbral.installation.tip: Cameras and terminals do not relay the signal. Coverage is a local sphere in the same dimension; it never loads chunks.
manual.umbral.installation.tags: connection wireless repeater radio cable coverage node network wiring
manual.umbral.surveillance.title: Watch through cameras
manual.umbral.surveillance.summary: VIGÍA displays the world already loaded by your client and lets you steer the lens from a terminal.
manual.umbral.surveillance.step1: Place VIGÍA on a wall, floor or ceiling. Select the core and pair the camera and terminal with the configurator.
manual.umbral.surveillance.step2: Open the terminal and choose Cameras. The directory shows connection and availability before opening a live view.
manual.umbral.surveillance.step3: Steer with the arrow keys; R centers, Space toggles scanning and G changes sweep range. F1 hides view details.
manual.umbral.surveillance.tip: Your character stays at the terminal. Cameras outside received chunks cannot provide video; the mod does not force chunk loading.
manual.umbral.surveillance.tags: cameras vigia camera monitor video view scan F1 servo
manual.umbral.entrance.title: Create an entrance
manual.umbral.entrance.summary: A metal door, reader and issued cards create a revocable entrance for your installation.
manual.umbral.entrance.step1: Place a door and reader you own within four blocks of each other. In NEXO, choose “Create access”, then the door, reader and optional FILTRO.
manual.umbral.entrance.step2: Review the selection and choose “Save device links”. Provide a signal to the devices; if you added FILTRO, configure its rules, mode and activation separately.
manual.umbral.entrance.step3: Open the reader with blank cards, issue a pass and give it to the visitor. Presenting it opens the door; revocation also invalidates its copies.
manual.umbral.entrance.tip: The wizard neither issues cards nor activates FILTRO. Passes work for their bearer and grant no building permissions. Manual configurator links remain available.
manual.umbral.entrance.tags: door access reader card pass revoke entrance exit
manual.umbral.defending.title: Defend the installation
manual.umbral.defending.summary: BALUARTE uses arrows and CENTELLA uses nuggets. Both consume real ammunition and target hostile creatures.
manual.umbral.defending.step1: Place and pair the turret to the core. Face it toward the approach you want to cover and keep its firing path clear.
manual.umbral.defending.step2: Open its panel, load compatible ammunition from your inventory and select the range. Then arm the turret.
manual.umbral.defending.step3: Use NEXO to check ammunition, connectivity and obstructions. A configured MOTA can refill ammunition from real stock.
manual.umbral.defending.tip: Turrets defend against mobs: they do not shoot players or pets. Territorial protection prevents other players from breaking blocks.
manual.umbral.defending.tags: defense turret baluarte centella arrows nuggets pve ammunition
manual.umbral.replenishing.title: Refill with MOTA
manual.umbral.replenishing.summary: A physical drone carries ammunition from an authorized chest or barrel to a turret, coordinated through NEXO.
manual.umbral.replenishing.step1: Pair a MOTA dock to the installation and use the drone item on the dock to install it.
manual.umbral.replenishing.step2: With the core selected, sneak and touch your chest or barrel with the configurator. Touch the dock, within 24 blocks, to assign that stock.
manual.umbral.replenishing.step3: Put compatible ammunition in stock. In CENTELLA device details, choose “MOTA ammo” if needed. Select the turret and choose “Request MOTA”; leave a clear route.
manual.umbral.replenishing.tip: Request each delivery through NEXO: an ammo preference does not schedule automatic refills. MOTA moves real items; check its status if blocked or out of stock.
manual.umbral.replenishing.tags: mota drone logistics refill chest barrel stock ammunition nexo
manual.umbral.core.title: Network core
manual.umbral.core.summary: Identifies the installation, ownership and paired devices. It is the origin of the local network.
manual.umbral.core.step1: Place it and select it with the configurator. Pair the other devices to that core afterwards.
manual.umbral.core.step2: Run copper cable to nodes or devices. The core also provides a local wireless sphere of 16 blocks.
manual.umbral.core.step3: Open its panel to check the network and access NEXO. Sneak-use the configurator to visualize coverage.
manual.umbral.core.tip: Breaking and replacing a core creates a new installation identity. Protected areas belong to your account and remain saved.
manual.umbral.cable.title: Copper cable
manual.umbral.cable.summary: Thin eight-sided cable with a small gap above the floor. Base inlets stay at that height; essential rises sit beside the fixed mount.
manual.umbral.cable.step1: Place a continuous run from the core to the device or node. To conceal it, run the line two blocks below the floor and rise beneath the door or the FILTRO column with the screen.
manual.umbral.cable.step2: Pair each device to the same core with the configurator: wiring does not change ownership or installation.
manual.umbral.cable.step3: Check the device panel. Cutting the run requires another valid route or local wireless coverage.
manual.umbral.cable.tip: The fixed metal base on doors and FILTRO covers the bottom input, leaving the side walls complete. Cable occupies its own cell and only transmits through loaded blocks.
manual.umbral.cable.tags: cable copper run physical wired connection
manual.umbral.node.title: Sector node
manual.umbral.node.summary: Extends local coverage when connected to the core by copper cable.
manual.umbral.node.step1: Select the core with the configurator and pair the node. Connect it to the core with a cable route.
manual.umbral.node.step2: Place paired cameras, terminals and other devices within its 16-block sphere to use local wireless coverage.
manual.umbral.node.step3: Sneak and touch the node with the configurator to inspect it and visualize coverage.
manual.umbral.node.tip: A node cannot use another node as a wireless uplink. Extend the cable to reach another sector.
manual.umbral.node.tags: node sector repeater radio wireless coverage 16
manual.umbral.terminal.title: Surveillance terminal
manual.umbral.terminal.summary: The installation monitor opens the camera directory and provides access to NEXO.
manual.umbral.terminal.step1: Place it on the floor or a wall and pair it to the core with the configurator.
manual.umbral.terminal.step2: Provide cable connectivity or local coverage. Open its panel and choose Cameras to select an available VIGÍA.
manual.umbral.terminal.step3: In NEXO, search devices, inspect notices or choose “Create access”. Use “?” to open terminal help.
manual.umbral.terminal.tip: A terminal is a control point, not a repeater. It requires connectivity and does not physically move your character.
manual.umbral.terminal.tags: device terminal monitor surveillance screen cameras nexo
manual.umbral.vigia.title: VIGÍA
manual.umbral.vigia.summary: One camera supports wall, floor and ceiling mounting with a movable servo head.
manual.umbral.vigia.step1: Place it on the block face appropriate to the mount. Pair it to the core with the configurator.
manual.umbral.vigia.step2: Check its connectivity and open it from Cameras on a terminal in the same installation.
manual.umbral.vigia.step3: Use arrows, centering, scanning and sweep range in the live view. Movement also appears on the physical head.
manual.umbral.vigia.tip: F1 hides view details. “?” ends the live session to read this guide; Back returns to the directory.
manual.umbral.vigia.tags: vigia camera wall floor ceiling lens servo scan video
manual.umbral.configurator.title: Configurator
manual.umbral.configurator.summary: The tool for pairing devices, inspecting coverage, assigning entrances and marking areas.
manual.umbral.configurator.step1: Touch a core, then the devices you want to pair. The overlay shows coordinates for the selected core, door or stock container.
manual.umbral.configurator.step2: Use it in the air to open Areas. Guided marking uses two corners; advanced mode supports outlines and cuts.
manual.umbral.configurator.step3: Follow the overlay’s “Use” and “Sneak + use” hints: they change with the block you aim at. Sneak-use in the air clears selections or cancels guided marking.
manual.umbral.configurator.tip: During area marking, clicks select points. Finish or cancel before pairing devices. F1 hides the overlay with the rest of the interface.
manual.umbral.configurator.tags: configurator tool pair mark selection sneak shift
manual.umbral.door.title: Security door
manual.umbral.door.summary: A metal door with two sliding leaves, upper glazing and animated opening.
manual.umbral.door.step1: Place it with space for its two-block height and pair it to the core.
manual.umbral.door.step2: In NEXO, use “Create access” to choose the door and reader, review and save. Alternatively, sneak-select it with the configurator and touch a paired reader.
manual.umbral.door.step3: The owner can operate it. Visitors present a valid pass to the reader; the interior exit lets them leave the enclosure.
manual.umbral.door.tip: To protect the surrounding structure and terrain, also confirm an area. A door alone does not protect the entire house.
manual.umbral.door.tags: door metal glass leaves animation exit access
manual.umbral.reader.title: Card reader
manual.umbral.reader.summary: Validates installation passes and opens its assigned door. Its panel manages issuing and revocation.
manual.umbral.reader.step1: Keep your reader and door within four blocks of each other. In NEXO, choose “Create access”, select both devices and save their links after reviewing them.
manual.umbral.reader.step2: Open the panel as owner. With blank cards in your inventory, choose Issue to create a pass.
manual.umbral.reader.step3: Give the pass to a visitor. To remove access, select it in the panel and revoke it; copies of that identity also stop working.
manual.umbral.reader.tip: If access fails, check connectivity, assigned door, installation and revocation. Matching a card name is not enough.
manual.umbral.reader.tags: reader cards issue revoke pass door authorization
manual.umbral.card.title: Access card
manual.umbral.card.summary: A bearer pass with its own identity. Crafted cards start blank.
manual.umbral.card.step1: Craft blank cards and carry them to a reader in your installation.
manual.umbral.card.step2: Open management as owner and issue the pass. Each issue is registered to that installation.
manual.umbral.card.step3: Use the issued card on a reader in the same installation. If lost, revoke it from the pass list.
manual.umbral.card.tip: Renaming a card does not change its identity or permissions. Carrying a pass does not grant device ownership.
manual.umbral.card.tags: access card pass blank issue identity revocation
manual.umbral.baluarte.title: BALUARTE
manual.umbral.baluarte.summary: A twin-bow turret that fires normal arrows with visible aiming, firing and reload motion.
manual.umbral.baluarte.step1: Pair it to the installation and open its panel with empty hands.
manual.umbral.baluarte.step2: Load normal arrows from your inventory, choose an 8, 12 or 16-block range and arm it.
manual.umbral.baluarte.step3: Keep the front clear: it needs a hostile target and an unobstructed projectile path. Refill manually or through MOTA.
manual.umbral.baluarte.tip: It does not use spectral or tipped arrows. Players and pets are excluded from targeting.
manual.umbral.baluarte.tags: baluarte turret bow arrows reload range pve
manual.umbral.centella.title: CENTELLA
manual.umbral.centella.summary: A nugget turret with its own chassis and weapon. The loaded metal determines damage and firing cadence.
manual.umbral.centella.step1: Pair it to the core and open its panel. Load copper, iron or gold nuggets from your inventory.
manual.umbral.centella.step2: The panel shows the loaded material and its values. Choose a range and arm the turret to defend against hostile creatures.
manual.umbral.centella.step3: Manual loading teaches the initial metal. The “MOTA: …” button chooses Automatic, Copper, Iron or Gold; the choice persists when empty. NEXO also offers it in device details.
manual.umbral.centella.tip: Automatic accepts any compatible metal when empty. The magazine cannot mix nuggets or components. Manually loading another metal keeps your explicit choice: MOTA waits until you unload or change it.
manual.umbral.centella.tags: centella turret nuggets copper iron gold damage cadence magazine
manual.umbral.sensor.title: Presence sensor
manual.umbral.sensor.summary: An oriented sensor detects intruders and hostile creatures in its cone and emits redstone.
manual.umbral.sensor.step1: Place it facing the approach and pair it to the installation.
manual.umbral.sensor.step2: Select the sensor in NEXO, adjust its range and arm it.
manual.umbral.sensor.step3: Use its redstone output for your mechanisms. If it detects nothing, check connectivity, direction and obstructions.
manual.umbral.sensor.tip: Detection respects its cone and line of sight. Owners, allies and valid pass holders are ignored; other players are detected.
manual.umbral.sensor.tags: sensor presence redstone cone detection alarm
manual.umbral.mine.title: Pulse mine
manual.umbral.mine.summary: A short-range defense that consumes physical redstone charges to pulse against hostile creatures.
manual.umbral.mine.step1: Place it on the ground and pair it to the core. Use the mine with empty hands to open its local NEXO control.
manual.umbral.mine.step2: Carry redstone in your inventory and choose Load. Once charged, arm the mine from its control.
manual.umbral.mine.step3: Check charges and status in NEXO. Disarm it before moving it; Unload retrieves stored charges.
manual.umbral.mine.tip: The mine does not destroy terrain or replace a protected area. Loading and unloading require its local control.
manual.umbral.mine.tags: mine pulse redstone charges defense proximity
manual.umbral.nexo.title: NEXO
manual.umbral.nexo.summary: The local installation assistant combines status readings, notices, history and specific commands.
manual.umbral.nexo.step1: Pair and open a NEXO terminal, or enter through a connected core or terminal. “Search devices…” matches names, types and coordinates, ignoring case and accents.
manual.umbral.nexo.step2: “Attention” lists problems; “All” shows the full directory. Each row displays its status. Select a device to use available actions or read why they are unavailable.
manual.umbral.nexo.step3: “…” opens device details: edit the name and choose “Save name”. “Create access” reviews a door, reader and optional FILTRO together. Areas manages protection.
manual.umbral.nexo.tip: NEXO follows game rules without external services. Notices neither expand areas nor request refills by themselves. Being disarmed is not an issue on its own; ammunition or signal shortages still appear in Attention.
manual.umbral.nexo.tags: nexo assistant ai intelligence terminal history notices control areas search attention name access
manual.umbral.dock.title: MOTA dock
manual.umbral.dock.summary: The maintenance drone installation, loading and recovery point.
manual.umbral.dock.step1: Place and pair the dock to the core. Use a MOTA item on it to install the drone.
manual.umbral.dock.step2: Assign your chest or barrel: select it while sneaking with the configurator, then touch the dock.
manual.umbral.dock.step3: Keep takeoff and routes to turrets clear. Check status through NEXO; cancel or recover when available.
manual.umbral.dock.tip: The stock link includes container identity. Replacing the chest requires assigning it again; the new inventory is not accessed automatically.
manual.umbral.dock.tags: dock mota drone stock logistics install recover
manual.umbral.mota.title: MOTA
manual.umbral.mota.summary: A logistics drone with physical flight, real cargo and a return trip to its dock.
manual.umbral.mota.step1: Install its item in a paired MOTA dock. Assign stock containing compatible ammunition.
manual.umbral.mota.step2: Select a turret in NEXO and choose “Request MOTA”. The drone collects what is needed and travels to the device.
manual.umbral.mota.step3: Check its status if blocked. Clear the route or cancel the job; remaining cargo must return or be recovered.
manual.umbral.mota.tip: It does not pass through walls or keep chunks loaded. Paused jobs or blocked routes need your intervention.
manual.umbral.mota.tags: mota drone helper transport flight ammunition refill
manual.umbral.matrix.title: Protection matrix
manual.umbral.matrix.summary: A craftable component that permanently increases your territorial capacity.
manual.umbral.matrix.step1: Craft matrices and carry them in your inventory. Recipe shows the actual pattern used in this world.
manual.umbral.matrix.step2: Mark or expand an area. Review shows the exact number of new matrices required before confirmation.
manual.umbral.matrix.step3: Confirm to install what is needed. Trimming or deleting an area frees capacity for other projects without returning consumed items.
manual.umbral.matrix.tip: There is no rent. The first 8 matrices add 2048 units each; the next 24 add 1024; later ones add 512. Horizontal extent carries more weight.
manual.umbral.matrix.tags: matrix protection cost price capacity copper iron redstone permanent
manual.umbral.book.title: Field manual
manual.umbral.book.summary: The portable book and contextual help use the same visual content.
manual.umbral.book.step1: You receive one on your first entry to each world or server unless its configuration disables the gift.
manual.umbral.book.step2: Use it with right-click. Search by words, switch the index and read Visual, Steps or Recipe.
manual.umbral.book.step3: If lost, craft another using the world recipe. Chapters also open through “?” without carrying the manual.
manual.umbral.book.tip: Death, dimension travel and reconnecting do not grant more copies. A full inventory delays delivery until there is a free slot.
manual.umbral.book.tags: book manual field documentation help recipe recover
manual.umbral.rooms.title: Rooms and permissions
manual.umbral.rooms.summary: Divide a protected base into rooms with building, use and inventory permissions.
manual.umbral.rooms.step1: Open the area and enable Advanced mode. Create a room inside the existing base and mark its shape.
manual.umbral.rooms.step2: In Permissions, select a player and choose building, use or inventory access as needed.
manual.umbral.rooms.step3: Review base environmental rules: explosions, fire, mobs, fluids, pistons and containers. Rooms inherit those rules.
manual.umbral.rooms.tip: A room must stay inside its base and does not duplicate territorial cost. Cards open entrances; these permissions manage the land.
manual.umbral.rooms.tags: rooms permissions members build use inventories rules spaces
manual.umbral.diagnostics.title: Something is not working
manual.umbral.diagnostics.summary: In NEXO, open “Attention” and read the device status. Check identity and connectivity, then resources, permissions and physical clearance.
manual.umbral.diagnostics.step1: Offline device: check the configurator’s selected core and the pairing. It needs a loaded cable route or valid coverage from a connected core or node.
manual.umbral.diagnostics.step2: No camera video: check received chunks. Idle turret: check arming, ammunition, hostile targets and a clear trajectory.
manual.umbral.diagnostics.step3: Stopped MOTA: check stock, route and “MOTA ammo”. If load and preference differ, unload or change the choice. Orange area: it is a proposal; review and confirm it.
manual.umbral.diagnostics.tip: Replaced devices may need pairing again. The manual is public information; opening help grants no control permissions.
manual.umbral.diagnostics.tags: failure error troubleshooting offline connection video ammunition blocked
manual.umbral.recovery.title: Recover and continue
manual.umbral.recovery.summary: Losing the book or disconnecting the installation does not erase saved protected areas.
manual.umbral.recovery.step1: Recover the manual by crafting it again. Device help remains available through “?” without the item.
manual.umbral.recovery.step2: If a MOTA job stops, inspect its dock status in NEXO before recovering the drone or removing resources.
manual.umbral.recovery.step3: To change a base, open its name in Areas. Its shape, permissions and installed capacity persist when you leave the world.
manual.umbral.recovery.tip: Saved protection does not depend on an active core connection. Proposals still need confirmation before they become protected.
manual.umbral.recovery.tags: recover lost book death reconnect saved persistence

nexo.umbral.refill.offline: Check the dock and turret connections.

nexo.umbral.refill.no_stock: Add stock matching the turret load and ammunition preference.

nexo.umbral.refill.blocked: Clear a path for MOTA between dock, stock and destination.
nexo.umbral.refill.ammo_mismatch: Ammunition and preference differ. Unload the turret or adjust its preference.

filter.umbral.intent.title: What should FILTRO do?
filter.umbral.intent.inform_summary: Records findings; does not block passage.
filter.umbral.intent.alarm_summary: Records findings and emits an alarm signal.
filter.umbral.intent.access_summary: Requires inspection and a card at the door.
filter.umbral.intent.inform_hint: Records the inspection and notifies the visitor and NEXO. No redstone output or door condition.
filter.umbral.intent.alarm_hint: Records findings and adds a redstone pulse. It does not prevent entry by itself.
filter.umbral.intent.access_hint: When a card is presented at the reader, the door requires a clear inspection and a valid pass. No invisible barrier or prevention of following another player; use an airlock for individual entry.
filter.umbral.intent.access_requirement: Needs a linked door and its reader.
